description_en: Removes tags from an Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) instance
description_zh: 为DDoS高防（中国内地）实例移除标签
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo delete-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --resource-ids ddoscoo-cn-zvp2eibz0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteTagResources

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Anti-DDoS instance. The value is fixed to cn-hangzhou, which indicates the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh: DoS高防实例所属地域ID。取值固定为cn-hangzhou，表示中国内地，即DDoS高防（中国内地）服务
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not set this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. The value is fixed to INSTANCE, which indicates an Anti-DDoS instance
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型。取值固定为INSTANCE，表示DDoS高防实例
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from the resource. Valid values:

true

false (default)
parameters.help_zh:
是否移除资源上的所有标签。取值：
true：表示是。
false（默认）：表示否
parameters.name: all

parameters.help_en: A list of IDs of the Anti-DDoS instances from which you want to remove tags
parameters.help_zh: 要移除标签的DDoS高防实例的ID列表
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en: A list of tag keys to remove
parameters.name: tag_key
